content.user_title: Find and Compare Grok Bots on bot.store
content.value_statement: Choosing a Grok Bot requires checking actual capabilities, prices, and access options. This skill guides marketplace searches, listing comparisons, and checkout handoffs for user-selected bots.
actual_capabilities: Search bot.store with a capability query and constraints supported by the current MCP tool schema.
Inspect an exact returned bot slug and compare facts supplied by its listing.
Preserve category, free-only, and budget requirements during marketplace searches.
Share a free bot's returned Grok link or open it upon user request.
Prepare checkout for a user-selected paid bot and convert returned GBP pence prices to pounds.
Distinguish checkout preparation from confirmed payment, ownership, and installation.
limitations: Requires a working connection to the remote bot.store MCP service; this skill does not implement the marketplace tools.
Listing facts do not provide independent evidence of bot quality or performance.
The human must sign in and approve payment on the checkout surface.
Checkout links do not provide protected paid bot access or prove ownership.

use_cases.title: Find a Free Writing Bot
use_cases.description: Search for writing templates, preserve a free-only constraint, and share a returned Grok link.

use_cases.title: Compare Task-Specific Templates
use_cases.description: Compare actual listing capabilities and prices for a recurring team task without inventing quality claims.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Selected Bot Purchase
use_cases.description: Inspect a chosen paid listing, state its price, and provide checkout for human payment approval.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Free Bot
prompt_templates.prompt: Find free Grok Bots on bot.store for [task]. Show actual listing facts and available Grok links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner discovery with a free-only requirement.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the bot.store listing at [URL or exact slug]. Summarize its returned capabilities, price, and access option.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a known candidate before deciding.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Within a Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare bot.store templates for [task] in [category] within [budget]. Preserve my constraints and identify facts missing from each listing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate comparison using supported search constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Checkout for My Selection
prompt_templates.prompt: I choose [exact returned slug] on bot.store. Verify its listing, state the price, and prepare checkout without claiming payment or ownership.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced checkout handoff after explicit listing selection.

output_examples.input: Find a free bot for my task when the marketplace returns no matching listings.
output_examples.output: No matching free bot was returned for your task. I have not substituted an invented listing or prepared checkout.

output_examples.input: Explain my status after preparing checkout for a selected paid bot.
output: Checkout is prepared for your selected listing.
Use the returned checkout link to sign in and approve payment.
Payment, ownership, and installation are not confirmed by checkout preparation.

output_examples.input: Explain how to compare two returned bot listings.
output: Compare the capabilities and prices provided by each listing.
Search relevance does not independently establish quality.

best_practices: Connect the intended bot.store MCP endpoint and use constraints supported by its current tool schema.
Inspect the exact returned slug and confirm the selected listing and price before preparing checkout.
Keep authentication and payment on checkout; verify purchase status before claiming ownership or installation.
anti_patterns: Inventing bot listings, ratings, performance claims, or prices when marketplace evidence is missing.
Preparing a paid bot's checkout before the user selects that exact listing.
Collecting payment secrets or treating a checkout link as proof of payment or protected bot access.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides bot.store searches, listing inspection, free Grok link sharing, and checkout preparation for user-selected paid bots.

faq.question: Does installing the skill buy a bot?
faq.answer: No. Skill installation is free and does not buy or install a paid bot.

faq.question: Do public marketplace tools need credentials?
faq.answer: The skill states that public MCP tools require no credentials. The human signs in on checkout when purchasing.

faq.question: Can it approve payment for me?
faq.answer: No. It prepares checkout for your selected listing. You approve payment on the checkout surface.

faq.question: What happens when no matching bot is found?
faq.answer: It reports the failed search or missing match without inventing a replacement bot.

faq.question: Are bot quality and installation independently verified?
faq.answer: No. Comparisons use listing facts. Ownership or installation claims require confirmation from the purchase surface.
